        Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakNegTraceOf (fun y => d.splitVisc • d.adjoint j p y + d.adjointSharp j p y)
            D.sharpTrace →
          MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.sharpTrace y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
              MeasureTheory.MemLp (d.adjointSharp j p) 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakGradientOf (d.adjointSharp j p) D.sharpGrad ∧
                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.sharpGrad MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.sharpGrad y))
                      MeasureTheory.volume →
            (∀ (l : Fin k),
                ContDiff ℝ 1 (D.pinPotential l) ∧
                  HasCompactSupport (D.pinPotential l) ∧
                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (D.pinSecond l) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                      Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakSecondDerivOf (fun y => fderiv ℝ (D.pinPotential l) y)
                          (D.pinSecond l) ∧
                        (∃ C, ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space), ‖D.pinSecond l y‖ ≤ C) ∧
                          Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakNegTraceOf (D.pinPotential l) (D.pinTrace l) ∧
                            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (D.pinTrace l) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                              ∃ C, ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space), ‖D.pinTrace l y‖ ≤ C) →
              (∀ (l : Fin k), 0 < D.pinScale l) →
                (∀ (l : Fin k) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                    d.smoothPin l y = (1 / D.pinScale l) • fderiv ℝ (D.pinPotential l) y) →
                  Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakScalarGradientOf D.pressure D.pressureGrad →
                    MeasureTheory.MemLp D.pressure 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                        MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.pressureGrad y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
                      Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakNegTraceOf D.dualField D.dualTrace →
                        MeasureTheory.MemLp D.dualField 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                            MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.dualTrace y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                              Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakGradientOf D.dualField D.dualGrad ∧
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.dualGrad MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.dualGrad y))
                                    MeasureTheory.volume →
                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakGradientOf D.potentialField D.potentialGrad →
                            Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakNegTraceOf D.potentialField D.potentialTrace →
                              MeasureTheory.MemLp D.potentialField 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.potentialGrad MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.potentialGrad y))
                                        MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                      MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.potentialTrace y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
                                0 ≤ D.potentialScale →
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakMatrixDivergenceOf D.fluxField D.fluxDiv →
                                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.fluxField MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.fluxField y))
                                            MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                          MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.fluxDiv y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
                                      (∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                          D.remainderField α d j p y =

                                                p i •
                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.convectionAdjointField (D.shiftField i)
                                                    (D.shiftGrad i) (d.adjoint j p) D.adjointGrad y) →
                                        (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                            ContDiff ℝ 1 (D.shiftField i) ∧
                                              (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), D.shiftGrad i y = fderiv ℝ (D.shiftField i) y) ∧
                                                (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                    Breakdown.divergenceAt (D.shiftField i) y = 0) ∧
                                                  ∃ C,
                                                    ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                      ‖D.shiftField i y‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖y‖)⁻¹ ∧
                                                        ‖D.shiftGrad i y‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-2)) →
                                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.l2Norm D.dualField ≤ D.dualBound →
                                            √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                    Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.potentialGrad y)) ≤
                                                D.potentialBound →
                                              √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.fluxField y)) ≤
                                                  D.fluxBound →
                                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.inverseSquarePart
                                                      MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                    MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.inverseSquarePart y) 2
                                                      MeasureTheory.volume →
                                                  (∀ k_1 ∉ D.inverseSquareModes,
                                                      ∀ (ρ z : ℝ),
                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.angularMode
                                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.horizontalPart
                                                                D.inverseSquarePart)
                                                              k_1 ρ z =
                                                            0 ∧
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.angularMode
                                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.verticalPart
                                                                D.inverseSquarePart)
                                                              k_1 ρ z =
                                                            0) →
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.harmonicWeightSqOn D.inverseSquareModes
                                                          D.inverseSquarePart ≤
                                                        ENNReal.ofReal (D.inverseSquareBound ^ 2) →
                                                      0 ≤ D.inverseSquareBound →
                                                        (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                            MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                                                (fun y =>
                                                                  ‖D.shiftField i y‖ ^ 2 * ‖d.adjoint j p y‖ ^ 2)
                                                                MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                              MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                                                (fun y =>
                                                                  ‖y‖ ^ 2 * ‖D.shiftGrad i y‖ ^ 2 *
                                                                    ‖d.adjoint j p y‖ ^ 2)
                                                                MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                                          (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                              √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                    ‖D.shiftField i y‖ ^ 2 * ‖d.adjoint j p y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                D.shiftBound i) →
                                                            (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                                √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                      ‖y‖ ^ 2 * ‖D.shiftGrad i y‖ ^ 2 *

declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} {V : Breakdown.Space → ℝ} {D : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.CellSumData},
  Even m ∧ 4 ≤ m →
    Measurable V →
      (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), 0 ≤ V y) →
        (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), V (Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.turnBy (2 * Real.pi / ↑m) y) = V y) →
          (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), V (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y) = V y) →
            (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount),
                0 ≤ D.pieceRhoLo b ∧
                  (∀ (h : ℝ), D.pieceRhoHi b = some h → D.pieceRhoLo b ≤ h) ∧
                    0 ≤ D.pieceZLo b ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), D.pieceZHi b = some h → D.pieceZLo b ≤ h) →
              (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount),
                  ∀ y ∈ D.pieceSolid b,
                    D.pieceRhoLo b ≤ Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.horizontalNorm y ∧
                      (∀ (h : ℝ), D.pieceRhoHi b = some h → Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.horizontalNorm y ≤ h) ∧
                        D.pieceZLo b ≤ y.ofLp 2 ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), D.pieceZHi b = some h → y.ofLp 2 ≤ h) →
                (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount), MeasurableSet (D.pieceSolid b)) →
                  (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount) (φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                      y ∈ D.pieceSolid b ↔ Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.turnBy φ y ∈ D.pieceSolid b) →
                    (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount), ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space), y ∈ D.pieceSolid b → V y ≤ D.pieceSup b) →
                      (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount), 0 ≤ D.pieceSup b) →
                        (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount), MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn V (D.pieceSolid b) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                          (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount), ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space) in D.pieceSolid b, V y ≤ D.pieceMass b) →
                            (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                V y ≠ 0 → ∃ b, y ∈ D.pieceSolid b ∨ Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y ∈ D.pieceSolid b) →
                              (∀ (ρ z : ℝ),
                                  0 ≤ ρ →
                                    0 ≤ z →
                                      ∃ a,
                                        D.boxRhoLo a ≤ ρ ∧
                                          (∀ (h : ℝ), D.boxRhoHi a = some h → ρ ≤ h) ∧
                                            D.boxZLo a ≤ z ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), D.boxZHi a = some h → z ≤ h) →
                                (∀ (a : Fin D.boxCount), 0 ≤ D.boxRhoLo a ∧ 0 ≤ D.boxZLo a) →
                                  (∀ (a : Fin D.boxCount) (b : Fin D.pieceCount) (mirrored : Bool),
                                      D.rule a b mirrored = 2 →
                                        0 < D.sectorLength a b mirrored ∧
                                          0 < D.sectorConst m a b ∧
                                            (D.pieceRhoHi b).isSome = true ∧ (D.pieceZHi b).isSome = true) →
                                    (∀ (a : Fin D.boxCount),
                                        ∑ b, ∑ mirrored, D.pairTerm m a b mirrored ≤ D.boxBound a) →

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsAdjointDual.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {d : Breakdown.SteadyCert.FracCertData k N} {j : Fin k} {p : Fin k → ℝ}
  {D : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.AdjointDual k},
  Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakGradientOf (d.adjoint j p) D.adjointGrad →
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (d.adjoint j p) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.adjointGrad MeasureTheory.volume →
      Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsAdjointRegular (d.adjoint j p) D.adjointGrad D.adjointSecond →
        Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakNegTraceOf (fun y => d.splitVisc • d.adjoint j p y + d.adjointSharp j p y)
            D.sharpTrace →
          MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.sharpTrace y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
              MeasureTheory.MemLp (d.adjointSharp j p) 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakGradientOf (d.adjointSharp j p) D.sharpGrad ∧
                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.sharpGrad MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.sharpGrad y))
                      MeasureTheory.volume →
            (∀ (l : Fin k),
                ContDiff ℝ 1 (D.pinPotential l) ∧
                  HasCompactSupport (D.pinPotential l) ∧
                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (D.pinSecond l) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                      Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakSecondDerivOf (fun y => fderiv ℝ (D.pinPotential l) y)
                          (D.pinSecond l) ∧
                        (∃ C, ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space), ‖D.pinSecond l y‖ ≤ C) ∧
                          Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakNegTraceOf (D.pinPotential l) (D.pinTrace l) ∧
                            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (D.pinTrace l) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                              ∃ C, ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space), ‖D.pinTrace l y‖ ≤ C) →
              (∀ (l : Fin k), 0 < D.pinScale l) →
                (∀ (l : Fin k) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                    d.smoothPin l y = (1 / D.pinScale l) • fderiv ℝ (D.pinPotential l) y) →
                  Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakScalarGradientOf D.pressure D.pressureGrad →
                    MeasureTheory.MemLp D.pressure 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                        MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.pressureGrad y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
                      Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakNegTraceOf D.dualField D.dualTrace →
                        MeasureTheory.MemLp D.dualField 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                            MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.dualTrace y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                              Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakGradientOf D.dualField D.dualGrad ∧
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.dualGrad MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.dualGrad y))
                                    MeasureTheory.volume →
                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakGradientOf D.potentialField D.potentialGrad →
                            Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakNegTraceOf D.potentialField D.potentialTrace →
                              MeasureTheory.MemLp D.potentialField 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.potentialGrad MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.potentialGrad y))
                                        MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                      MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.potentialTrace y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
                                0 ≤ D.potentialScale →
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakMatrixDivergenceOf D.fluxField D.fluxDiv →
                                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.fluxField MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.fluxField y))
                                            MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                          MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.fluxDiv y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
                                      (∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                          D.remainderField α d j p y =
                                            D.inverseSquarePart y +
                                              ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ \ D.exactSet,
                                                p i •
                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.convectionAdjointField (D.shiftField i)
                                                    (D.shiftGrad i) (d.adjoint j p) D.adjointGrad y) →
                                        (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                            ContDiff ℝ 1 (D.shiftField i) ∧
                                              (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), D.shiftGrad i y = fderiv ℝ (D.shiftField i) y) ∧
                                                (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                    Breakdown.divergenceAt (D.shiftField i) y = 0) ∧
                                                  ∃ C,
                                                    ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                      ‖D.shiftField i y‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖y‖)⁻¹ ∧
                                                        ‖D.shiftGrad i y‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-2)) →
                                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.l2Norm D.dualField ≤ D.dualBound →
                                            √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                    Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.potentialGrad y)) ≤
                                                D.potentialBound →
                                              √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.fluxField y)) ≤
                                                  D.fluxBound →
                                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.inverseSquarePart
                                                      MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                    MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.inverseSquarePart y) 2
                                                      MeasureTheory.volume →
                                                  (∀ k_1 ∉ D.inverseSquareModes,
                                                      ∀ (ρ z : ℝ),
                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.angularMode
                                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.horizontalPart
                                                                D.inverseSquarePart)
                                                              k_1 ρ z =
                                                            0 ∧
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.angularMode
                                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.verticalPart
                                                                D.inverseSquarePart)
                                                              k_1 ρ z =
                                                            0) →
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.harmonicWeightSqOn D.inverseSquareModes
                                                          D.inverseSquarePart ≤
                                                        ENNReal.ofReal (D.inverseSquareBound ^ 2) →
                                                      0 ≤ D.inverseSquareBound →
                                                        (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                            MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                                                (fun y =>
                                                                  ‖D.shiftField i y‖ ^ 2 * ‖d.adjoint j p y‖ ^ 2)
                                                                MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                              MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                                                (fun y =>
                                                                  ‖y‖ ^ 2 * ‖D.shiftGrad i y‖ ^ 2 *
                                                                    ‖d.adjoint j p y‖ ^ 2)
                                                                MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                                          (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                              √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                    ‖D.shiftField i y‖ ^ 2 * ‖d.adjoint j p y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                D.shiftBound i) →
                                                            (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                                √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                      ‖y‖ ^ 2 * ‖D.shiftGrad i y‖ ^ 2 *
                                                                        ‖d.adjoint j p y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                  D.shiftGradBound i) →
                                                              Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsAdjointDual α d j p D

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsCellSumData.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} {V : Breakdown.Space → ℝ} {D : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.CellSumData},
  Even m ∧ 4 ≤ m →
    Measurable V →
      (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), 0 ≤ V y) →
        (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), V (Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.turnBy (2 * Real.pi / ↑m) y) = V y) →
          (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), V (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y) = V y) →
            (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount),
                0 ≤ D.pieceRhoLo b ∧
                  (∀ (h : ℝ), D.pieceRhoHi b = some h → D.pieceRhoLo b ≤ h) ∧
                    0 ≤ D.pieceZLo b ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), D.pieceZHi b = some h → D.pieceZLo b ≤ h) →
              (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount),
                  ∀ y ∈ D.pieceSolid b,
                    D.pieceRhoLo b ≤ Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.horizontalNorm y ∧
                      (∀ (h : ℝ), D.pieceRhoHi b = some h → Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.horizontalNorm y ≤ h) ∧
                        D.pieceZLo b ≤ y.ofLp 2 ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), D.pieceZHi b = some h → y.ofLp 2 ≤ h) →
                (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount), MeasurableSet (D.pieceSolid b)) →
                  (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount) (φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                      y ∈ D.pieceSolid b ↔ Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.turnBy φ y ∈ D.pieceSolid b) →
                    (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount), ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space), y ∈ D.pieceSolid b → V y ≤ D.pieceSup b) →
                      (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount), 0 ≤ D.pieceSup b) →
                        (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount), MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn V (D.pieceSolid b) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                          (∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount), ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space) in D.pieceSolid b, V y ≤ D.pieceMass b) →
                            (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                V y ≠ 0 → ∃ b, y ∈ D.pieceSolid b ∨ Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y ∈ D.pieceSolid b) →
                              (∀ (ρ z : ℝ),
                                  0 ≤ ρ →
                                    0 ≤ z →
                                      ∃ a,
                                        D.boxRhoLo a ≤ ρ ∧
                                          (∀ (h : ℝ), D.boxRhoHi a = some h → ρ ≤ h) ∧
                                            D.boxZLo a ≤ z ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), D.boxZHi a = some h → z ≤ h) →
                                (∀ (a : Fin D.boxCount), 0 ≤ D.boxRhoLo a ∧ 0 ≤ D.boxZLo a) →
                                  (∀ (a : Fin D.boxCount) (b : Fin D.pieceCount) (mirrored : Bool),
                                      D.rule a b mirrored = 2 →
                                        0 < D.sectorLength a b mirrored ∧
                                          0 < D.sectorConst m a b ∧
                                            (D.pieceRhoHi b).isSome = true ∧ (D.pieceZHi b).isSome = true) →
                                    (∀ (a : Fin D.boxCount),
                                        ∑ b, ∑ mirrored, D.pairTerm m a b mirrored ≤ D.boxBound a) →
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsCellSumData m V D

  {V : Breakdown.Space → ℝ} →
    {D : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.CellSumData} →
      {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsCellSumData m V D → Sort u} →
        ((order_even : Even m ∧ 4 ≤ m) →
            (measurable : Measurable V) →
              (nonneg : ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), 0 ≤ V y) →
                (turn_invariant :
                    ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), V (Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.turnBy (2 * Real.pi / ↑m) y) = V y) →
                  (mirror_even : ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), V (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y) = V y) →
                    (piece_box :
                        ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount),
                          0 ≤ D.pieceRhoLo b ∧
                            (∀ (h : ℝ), D.pieceRhoHi b = some h → D.pieceRhoLo b ≤ h) ∧
                              0 ≤ D.pieceZLo b ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), D.pieceZHi b = some h → D.pieceZLo b ≤ h) →
                      (piece_solid :
                          ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount),
                            ∀ y ∈ D.pieceSolid b,
                              D.pieceRhoLo b ≤ Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.horizontalNorm y ∧
                                (∀ (h : ℝ),
                                    D.pieceRhoHi b = some h → Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.horizontalNorm y ≤ h) ∧
                                  D.pieceZLo b ≤ y.ofLp 2 ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), D.pieceZHi b = some h → y.ofLp 2 ≤ h) →
                        (solid_measurable : ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount), MeasurableSet (D.pieceSolid b)) →

                              ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount) (φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                y ∈ D.pieceSolid b ↔ Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.turnBy φ y ∈ D.pieceSolid b) →
                            (sup_le :
                                ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount),
                                  ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space), y ∈ D.pieceSolid b → V y ≤ D.pieceSup b) →
                              (sup_nonneg : ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount), 0 ≤ D.pieceSup b) →
                                (mass_integrable :
                                    ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount),
                                      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn V (D.pieceSolid b) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                  (mass_le :
                                      ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount),
                                        ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space) in D.pieceSolid b, V y ≤ D.pieceMass b) →
                                    (support :
                                        ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                          V y ≠ 0 →

                                                ∃ a,
                                                  D.boxRhoLo a ≤ ρ ∧
                                                    (∀ (h : ℝ), D.boxRhoHi a = some h → ρ ≤ h) ∧

                                        (box_lower : ∀ (a : Fin D.boxCount), 0 ≤ D.boxRhoLo a ∧ 0 ≤ D.boxZLo a) →

  v y - (1 / (2 * α)) • v y + (1 / (2 * α)) • (G y) y +
                (c.rotationRate p • (G y) (Breakdown.axialTurn y) - c.rotationRate p • Breakdown.axialTurn (v y)) -
              c.splitVisc • Breakdown.SteadyCert.secondTrace (H y) +
            ((G y) (c.profile p y) + (fderiv ℝ (c.profile p) y) (v y)) +
          ∑ i, κ i • c.actuator i y -
        (v y - (1 / (2 * α)) • v y + (1 / (2 * α)) • (G y) y +
                  (c.modelRate • (G y) (Breakdown.axialTurn y) - c.modelRate • Breakdown.axialTurn (v y)) -
                c.splitVisc • Breakdown.SteadyCert.secondTrace (H y) +
              Breakdown.CellCert.crossVec (Breakdown.CellCert.curlOf (G y)) (c.modelVelocity y) +
            Breakdown.CellCert.crossVec (c.modelCurl y) (v y) +
          ∑ i, κ i • c.modelActuator i y) +
      -((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ c.centre y)) (v y) + (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (G y)) (c.centre y)) =
    (G y) (c.profile p y) - (G y) (c.centre y) + ((fderiv ℝ (c.profile p) y) (v y) - (fderiv ℝ c.centre y) (v y)) +
            ((G y) (c.centre y) + (fderiv ℝ c.centre y) (v y) -
                    Breakdown.CellCert.crossVec (Breakdown.CellCert.curlOf (fderiv ℝ c.centre y)) (v y) -

          (Breakdown.CellCert.crossVec (Breakdown.CellCert.curlOf (fderiv ℝ c.centre y)) (v y) -
            Breakdown.CellCert.crossVec (c.modelCurl y) (v y)) +
        (c.rotationRate p • (G y) (Breakdown.axialTurn y) - c.modelRate • (G y) (Breakdown.axialTurn y) -
          (c.rotationRate p • Breakdown.axialTurn (v y) - c.modelRate • Breakdown.axialTurn (v y))) +

declarations.type:

  2 ≤ c.order →
    (∀ (a : Fin N) (φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),

          c.row a (Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.turnBy φ y) =
            Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.turnBy φ
              (Real.cos (↑(T.modeNum a) * φ) • c.row a y + Real.sin (↑(T.modeNum a) * φ) • c.row (T.partner a) y)) →
      (∀ (a : Fin N), T.partner (T.partner a) = a) →
        (∀ (a : Fin N), T.modeNum (T.partner a) = -T.modeNum a) →
          (∀ (a : Fin N), T.cellOf (T.partner a) = T.cellOf a) →
            (∀ (a : Fin N), c.rowWeight (T.partner a) = c.rowWeight a) →
              (∀ (a : Fin N), T.modeNum a ≠ 0 → ↑c.order ≤ |↑(T.modeNum a)|) →
                (∀ (a : Fin N), ↑c.order ∣ T.modeNum a) →
                  (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasurableSet (T.cellSet i)) →
                    (∀ (i : ℕ), Bornology.IsBounded (T.cellSet i)) →
                      (∀ (i : ℕ) (φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                          y ∈ T.cellSet i ↔ Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.turnBy φ y ∈ T.cellSet i) →
                        (∀ (i j : ℕ), i ≠ j → MeasureTheory.volume (T.cellSet i ∩ T.cellSet j) = 0) →
                          (∀ (a : Fin N), ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space), c.row a y ≠ 0 → y ∈ T.cellSet (T.cellOf a)) →
                            (∀ (i : ℕ),
                                ∀ y ∈ T.cellSet i, Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.horizontalNorm y ≤ T.outerRadius i) →
                              (∀ (a b : Fin N),
                                  Breakdown.SteadyCert.l2Pair (c.row a) (c.row b) = if a = b then 1 else 0) →
                                (∀ (a : Fin N), MeasureTheory.MemLp (c.row a) 2 MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                  (∀ (a : Fin N), 0 ≤ c.rowWeight a) →
                                    (0 ≤ T.rateRowConst ∧
                                        ∀ (a : Fin N),
                                          T.modeNum a ≠ 0 →

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsCellSumData.recOn
declarations.type:
{m : ℕ} →
  {V : Breakdown.Space → ℝ} →
    {D : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.CellSumData} →
      {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsCellSumData m V D → Sort u} →
        (t : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsCellSumData m V D) →
          ((order_even : Even m ∧ 4 ≤ m) →
              (measurable : Measurable V) →
                (nonneg : ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), 0 ≤ V y) →
                  (turn_invariant :
                      ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), V (Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.turnBy (2 * Real.pi / ↑m) y) = V y) →
                    (mirror_even : ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), V (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y) = V y) →
                      (piece_box :
                          ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount),
                            0 ≤ D.pieceRhoLo b ∧
                              (∀ (h : ℝ), D.pieceRhoHi b = some h → D.pieceRhoLo b ≤ h) ∧
                                0 ≤ D.pieceZLo b ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), D.pieceZHi b = some h → D.pieceZLo b ≤ h) →
                        (piece_solid :
                            ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount),
                              ∀ y ∈ D.pieceSolid b,
                                D.pieceRhoLo b ≤ Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.horizontalNorm y ∧
                                  (∀ (h : ℝ),
                                      D.pieceRhoHi b = some h → Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.horizontalNorm y ≤ h) ∧
                                    D.pieceZLo b ≤ y.ofLp 2 ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), D.pieceZHi b = some h → y.ofLp 2 ≤ h) →
                          (solid_measurable : ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount), MeasurableSet (D.pieceSolid b)) →
                            (solid_turn :
                                ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount) (φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  y ∈ D.pieceSolid b ↔ Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.turnBy φ y ∈ D.pieceSolid b) →
                              (sup_le :
                                  ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount),
                                    ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space), y ∈ D.pieceSolid b → V y ≤ D.pieceSup b) →
                                (sup_nonneg : ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount), 0 ≤ D.pieceSup b) →
                                  (mass_integrable :
                                      ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount),
                                        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn V (D.pieceSolid b) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                    (mass_le :
                                        ∀ (b : Fin D.pieceCount),
                                          ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space) in D.pieceSolid b, V y ≤ D.pieceMass b) →
                                      (support :
                                          ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                            V y ≠ 0 →
                                              ∃ b,
                                                y ∈ D.pieceSolid b ∨ Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y ∈ D.pieceSolid b) →
                                        (box_cover :
                                            ∀ (ρ z : ℝ),
                                              0 ≤ ρ →
                                                0 ≤ z →
                                                  ∃ a,
                                                    D.boxRhoLo a ≤ ρ ∧
                                                      (∀ (h : ℝ), D.boxRhoHi a = some h → ρ ≤ h) ∧
                                                        D.boxZLo a ≤ z ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), D.boxZHi a = some h → z ≤ h) →
                                          (box_lower : ∀ (a : Fin D.boxCount), 0 ≤ D.boxRhoLo a ∧ 0 ≤ D.boxZLo a) →
                                            (near_valid :
                                                ∀ (a : Fin D.boxCount) (b : Fin D.pieceCount) (mirrored : Bool),
                                                  D.rule a b mirrored = 2 →
                                                    0 < D.sectorLength a b mirrored ∧
                                                      0 < D.sectorConst m a b ∧
                                                        (D.pieceRhoHi b).isSome = true ∧ (D.pieceZHi b).isSome = true) →
                                              (box_sum :
                                                  ∀ (a : Fin D.boxCount),
                                                    ∑ b, ∑ mirrored, D.pairTerm m a b mirrored ≤ D.boxBound a) →
                                                motive ⋯) →
            motive t
